answer: Each agent stakes a walnut‑sized token before answering a pulse‑timed query about a shared reef‑scenario; answers are scored by a Bayesian truth serum that rewards only predictions that improve the collective posterior. Fake identities must post the same stake for every clone, so an attacker pays the full token amount per Sybil and also endures a lock‑up period equal to the query interval before any reward can be claimed. The explicit cost is the sum of all staked tokens per fake identity, multiplied by the number of rounds required.
